subject: English
question_text: Match the parts of sentences given in column 'A' and column
stimulus: 'B' to write five complete sentences. There are more parts of sentences in column 'B' than required. 1×5=5 Column A Column B (a) The cyclone is curse (i) within few hours (b) Violent cyclones (ii) rare in Bangladesh usually occur (c) The cyclone causes (iii) in the tonics (d) The people likely to (iv) a great havoc be affected by cyclone (e) The cyclone is supposed (v) to the coastal people to commence (vi) a blessing (vii) should be given previous warning
guide_solution: Matching (a) + (v) The cyclone is a curse to the coastal people. (b) + ii) Violent cyclones usually occur rare in Bangladesh. (c) + (iv) The cyclone causes a great havoc. (d) + (vii) The people likely to be affected by cyclone should be given previous warning. (e) + (vi) The cyclone is supposed to commence a blessing.
